repos_data.description: Hindsight: Agent Memory That Learns
Cognee is the open-source AI memory platform for agents. Give your AI agents persistent long-term memory with small models for free
Memory that AI Agents Love!

A cyber brain for your AI. It never forgets a detail, remembers exactly what you said, and learns how you work over time. Free, local, works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes and more. MIT.

Open-source coding agents memory. Records issues, attempts, fixes and decisions, then warns your agent before it repeats an approach that already failed. Native MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity and Codex. 100% local, no cloud, no telemetry. MIT.

Self-hosted MCP gateway and company brain for AI agents: connect Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot to your ERP, APIs, databases and file servers, with company memory, skills, knowledge graph, SSO/RBAC and audit. 691 connectors (SAP, Odoo, SQL…). Open source, EU cloud.
Local, LLM-free memory for AI agents. A single offline Rust binary — deterministic and auditable — that learns from use, forgets the irrelevant, and strengthens what matters. No cloud, no API keys.
Human-like memory for AI agents — semantic, episodic & procedural. Experience-driven procedures that learn from failures. Free API, Python & JS SDKs, LangChain, CrewAI & OpenClaw integrations.

Long-term memory for your AI companion, on your own Cloudflare account. Captures instantly, extracts every 4 hours, consolidates nightly, with six memory layers and a visual curation panel. QQ group: 1091783659
Self-hosted mem0 MCP server for Claude Code. Run a complete memory server against self-hosted Qdrant + Neo4j + Ollama while using Claude as the main LLM.
Persistent memory for AI coding agents. Local-first, cross-session context, global knowledge, and optional autonomous task execution.
MCP server with persistent memory + FTS5 search for Claude Code conversation history. Index your ~/.claude/projects/, expose 10 MCP tools, browse via web UI. MIT-licensed.
Memory layer for AI agents — SDKs, CLI and MCP server for Membase
A lightweight persistent-memory companion for OpenCode & Claude
🧠 Self-hosted, privacy-first MCP server for long-term AI memory — save, search & summarize Claude/ChatGPT chat history locally. No cloud, no database.

Persistent local memory for AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, any MCP client. Temporal knowledge graph, procedural memory, AST codebase ingest, cross-project analogy. LongMemEval R@5 95.1%, LoCoMo 0.607, BEAM 1M 0.448. 74 MCP tools, 9 IDEs, 100% local.
Local-first memory for AI agents about the people in your life. MCP server + CLI on SQLite. Never phones home.
Outcome-based persistent memory MCP server for Claude Code and OpenCode. Good advice promoted, bad advice demoted. pip install roampal.
The #1 Obsidian MCP for AI memory — freshness-aware, cited, local-first and read-only by default. Dataview, Bases, PDFs, every agent.
Notes for iPhone and Mac that ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code and Codex can read and edit. Feels like Apple Notes, imports it too. Open source, encrypted.
Memory engine for AI agents — time axis (3-layer decay/promotion) + space axis (self-organizing topic tree). Hybrid search, LLM consolidation. Single Rust binary.
NEXO runtime core for NEXO Desktop: local memory, automation, MCP tools and update-managed runtime.

Hosted persistent memory for AI agents over MCP. Tell it a recalled memory helped or misled, and it re-ranks what comes back next. Shared rooms for multi-agent work. One key or OAuth across Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and ChatGPT. MIT, in the official MCP Registry.

Dynamic agent memory for LLM agents: 7 neuroscience-inspired layers (working, episodic, semantic, procedural) with FSRS spaced repetition and memory consolidation. Zero-dependency TypeScript library, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, Vercel AI SDK middleware. Paper: arXiv 2604.23878 · reproduction packages on Zenodo.

Embedded long-term memory database for AI agents & LLM apps. Six-layer cognitive architecture, knowledge graph, hybrid BM25 + vector search, sleep-time memory consolidation. One .meh file, zero infrastructure, pure Go.
Open-source cognitive engine for AI agents — persistent memory, a first-person journal, a four-layer ethics engine, and a per-user biological clock, over MCP. Apache-2.0.
Durable, local-first memory for AI coding agents over MCP — zero-dependency, curated & semantically de-duped, you own the data (SQLite + Markdown). Works with Claude Code, Codex & any MCP host.
High-fidelity transcript memory for Claude Code — index every session, recall byte-identical, search, prune, compose. Local-first, stdlib-only, MCP.
Git-native decision memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents. Preserve constraints and rejected alternatives; surface only the decisions still in force.

Zaxy turns agent work into durable, auditable memory: a hash-chained Eventloom log as the source of truth, an embedded temporal knowledge graph for reasoning (local-first, no sidecar; Neo4j/Postgres optional), cited Memory Checkout for compact context, and MCP tools for  model-facing retrieval, capture, and feedback.
Remembra Relay: one agent stops, the next one already knows. Session handoffs built from git facts, for the next coding agent in any MCP tool, on any machine. MCP server + CLI. MIT.
Lossless local memory for Claude Code. The full, unabbreviated version. Every tool call, every file edit, every thinking block — stored verbatim on your machine. Persistent memory without tokens.
XMemo: user-owned Memory OS for AI agents. Public client (@xmemo/client), MCP distribution, Skills and plugins.
Local long-term memory for AI agents. Keeps every conversation word for word, costs nothing to save, and is shared by all your agents. 88.8% on LongMemEval.
Persistent AI memory with hybrid search and embedded sync. Open, free, unlimited.
Shared memory layer for AI coding tools. One local SQLite DB, every tool reads the same verified facts. Local-first, zero cloud.
Shared project memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP coding tools — one brain.klypix file committed with your code.

Auditable memory layer for AI agents: zero-LLM-call local ingest (~10ms/msg, air-gapped), matches Mem0 on accuracy at ~1000x lower ingest cost, bi-temporal belief-state, MCP server. Honest LoCoMo/LongMemEval benchmarks. Open source (Apache-2.0).
🧠 Persistent memory for AI agents. SQLite for agent state. Zero cloud dependencies. Local embeddings. MCP-native integration with Claude Desktop/Code, Cursor, Windsurf & more.
Git-first memory for AI agents: Markdown files are truth, the index is disposable, writes are reviewable commits.
Private local memory for any AI agent: Markdown database, SQLite search, MCP, zero runtime dependencies.
Go SDK for Dakera AI agent memory — self-hosted, 88.2% LoCoMo. Vectors, hybrid search, knowledge graphs, sessions.
Open-source team memory layer for AI coding agents — markdown files in git, user→team→org hierarchy, cross-vendor MCP server. Apache-2.0.
The open-source, self-organizing memory for all your AI tools. Single-tenant, yours, over MCP.
🧠 Persistent memory for AI Agents. Free trial → https://portal.penfield.app/sign-up
Local-first memory layer for AI coding agents — Markdown as source of truth, MCP server + CLI, human-reviewed capture, team knowledge via git PRs.
Local-first long-term memory for AI agents. MCP, hooks, and handoff across Cursor, Claude, and other IDEs — no cloud, no API keys.
Substrate-based context compaction for Claude Code. Inspectable signal weights, local-only, MCP-ready. Alternative to /compact + hook-based capture (claude-mem, etc.).
A memory for your AI coding assistant. It keeps what you tell it and hands the right note back at the moment it matters. Runs entirely on your own machine.
Forge a second brain your AI agents can read — a CLI that generates and validates AI-readable memory vaults. A Sunsato product.

The universal remote for AI: persistent memory, shared context and tools through MCP. Public clients, connectors and docs for UnClick. Hosted service: unclick.world. Includes a historical July 2026 platform snapshot.

🧠 A high-performance PostgreSQL-backed MCP server acting as a super memory, task tracker, and dynamic database manager for AI agents. Features built-in connection pooling, a professional tasks schema, and a unique shared multi-agent coordination hub to prevent coding conflicts in real-time.
MCP Memxus

Verified knowledge for AI agents.  Compress context, extract and store facts, define rules, and ask questions — get deterministic answers with proof, not LLM guesses. Connect agents via MCP, Python SDK, TypeSc
MCP server and local sync package for Cosmos. Connects agents, iMessage, browser history, calendar, Claude Desktop, and shell history to a shared personal graph.
The associative memory layer for LLM agents — recall by association, not just similarity.
Local AI memory: neuroscience-inspired Data→Information→Knowledge in SQLite you own.
A personal knowledge graph for Claude that survives across sessions, devices, and tools. Neo4j + semantic embeddings, OAuth-secured, single-user-by-default but multi-tenant-ready.
Connect Cortex, patent-pending semantic memory for AI agents, to Claude or any MCP client. Free trial, 2-minute setup.
Local, file-based shared long-term memory for AI coding assistants — SQLite + FTS5, no daemon, no cloud. Access via MCP, CLI, JSONL bridge or raw SQLite.
A git-aware, evidence-based memory store for AI coding agents
UseCortex MCP Server — Give your AI coding agent a persistent memory. Read and write knowledge from any tool.
Persistent, graph-based memory for Roo Code via MCP
Signed receipts for the work your AI agent does. MCP server, SDK, CLI, dashboard and Magic Folder. Verify offline. Local-first, MIT.
Long-term memory for AI assistants: permanent, portable across clients, searchable and exportable. Hosted MCP server.
ArkHive — local-first governed memory for AI agents: tamper-evident SHA-256 ledger for identity, audit history, verification, and constraint-aware decisions. Apache-2.0.
BrainTube: persistent AI memory over your saved YouTube videos, podcasts, articles and PDFs. One remote MCP endpoint that works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client.
